انتبهتما (form VIII)
# اِنْتَبَهْتُمَا (intabahtumā) /in.ta.bah.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
# اُنْتُبِهْتُمَا (untubihtumā) /un.tu.bih.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
